name: Sarah Knafo - § 103 - Am 7
title: REPORT on European technological sovereignty and digital infrastructure
part_text: 103. Calls on the Commission to take the necessary actions to ensure a reliable and sufficient energy supply to support the digital infrastructure of the future, by promoting energy generation using all available sources and by developing plans to increase strategic energy autonomy based on the principle of technological neutrality, as well as by making appropriate investments in electricity grids to eliminate the existing bottlenecks and network congestion that hinder industry and innovation;
